items.question: What are your opening hours?
items.answer: We are open daily from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM. You can visit us for dine-in, takeaway, or place an order online anytime.

items.question: Do you offer vegetarian options?
items.answer: Yes! We offer a wide variety of delicious vegetarian dishes prepared with fresh ingredients. You can explore our menu to discover all available options.

items.question: Can I place an order online?
items.answer: Yes, you can place your order online through our website. Simply browse our menu, select your favourite dishes and proceed to checkout.

items.question: Do you provide home delivery?
items.answer: Yes, we provide home delivery services. You can order your favourite meals online and enjoy freshly prepared food at home.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept various payment methods, including cash, debit cards, credit cards and supported online payment options.
